aggressive_definition: Advanced prostate cancer cases; the abstract does not provide criteria for defining advanced disease.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: results were similar when restricted to prostate-specific antigen-normal controls or to advanced cases.
study_design: Multicenter population-based case-control study of African-American, white, Japanese, and Chinese men.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Cases (n = 1619) with histologically confirmed prostate cancer were identified through the population-based tumor registries of Hawaii, San Francisco, and Los Angeles in the United States and British Columbia and Ontario in Canada. Controls (n = 1618) were frequency-matched to cases on ethnicity, age, and region of residence of the case, in a ratio of approximately 1:1.
reason: The abstract analyzes overall prostate cancer risk and separately reports analyses restricted to advanced cases. The number and defining criteria of advanced cases are not stated.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Intake of legumes (whether total legumes, soyfoods specifically, or other legumes) was inversely related to prostate cancer (OR for highest relative to lowest quintile for total legumes = 0.62; P for trend = 0.0002); results were similar when restricted to prostate-specific antigen-normal controls or to advanced cases.
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported OR of 0.62 is the overall prostate cancer estimate. The statement that advanced-case results were similar does not make this numeric overall estimate an aggressive estimate.
